grammar.name: Subject pronouns + essere
grammar.scope: io/tu/lui/lei/Lei/noi/voi/loro; present of essere; nationality adjectives; greetings ciao/buongiorno/buonasera/arrivederci; mi chiamo as a fixed phrase

chapters.a_plot: Moving day on Via dei Tigli. Ben tries to introduce himself to every neighbour with the three sentences he has memorised; Ornella watches from her window, Roberto asks who he is and why the van is in *his* space.
chapters.b_plot: Leo's first day at Scuola Rodari: he introduces himself to the class and to Pietro. Emma refuses to say more than 'ciao' to anyone.
chapters.runner: Franco watches the move from across the street and says only 'Mah.'
chapters.arc: Series premiere: establishes every household. The first confessionali: 'Mi chiamo Ben. Sono americano.'

grammar.name: Nouns: gender and number
grammar.scope: -o/-a/-e endings, regular plurals, common exceptions (il caffè, la foto, il problema); vorrei as a fixed phrase

chapters.theme: At the bar: coffee, pastries, drinks; ordering politely
chapters.a_plot: Ben's first morning at Bar Tigli: he orders a cappuccino at 4 p.m., asks for 'latte' and gets milk, and tries to sit down without paying first. Matteo is thrilled to have a new regular.
chapters.b_plot: The first Sunday lunch at Franco's. Franco serves a four-course meal and Ben thinks the pasta is the main course.
chapters.runner: Ben starts his notebook of new words.
chapters.arc: Ben vs Franco begins: Franco calls him 'l'americano' for the first time.

grammar.name: Definite articles
grammar.scope: il, lo, la, l', i, gli, le and when to use each; articles with nouns introduced so far

chapters.a_plot: Unpacking chaos: nothing fits, the kitchen is tiny, and every box is labelled in English. Chiara directs, Ben loses the box with the coffee maker.
chapters.b_plot: Emma and Leo fight over the bigger bedroom. Leo labels everything in the house with sticky notes in Italian.
chapters.runner: Ornella's cat Pavarotti moves in with the Carters for an afternoon.
chapters.arc: The house is rented and too small, which sets up the S2 renovation.

title.en: There's a Bar in the Square

grammar.name: Indefinite articles + c'è / ci sono
grammar.scope: un, uno, una, un'; c'è / ci sono; dov'è?

chapters.theme: Places in town: shops, services, the piazza
chapters.a_plot: Ben explores Borgoverde on foot with Leo, making a 'map' of what there is: a church, a pharmacy, a bakery, a station. They meet Nadia at the Farmacia Centrale.
chapters.b_plot: Chiara's first commute into Milan; the train is late and her new boss, Marchetti, is not.
chapters.runner: Roberto's first printed notice appears on the Carters' gate.

grammar.name: Avere + avere expressions
grammar.scope: present of avere; avere ... anni, fame, sete, freddo, caldo, sonno, paura, fretta, ragione

chapters.a_plot: Sunday lunch again: Franco quizzes Ben about his family ('Quanti fratelli hai?'); Ben answers everything with 'Ho fame'.
chapters.b_plot: Leo tells Ornella about his family and learns she has no grandchildren. He decides she needs one.
chapters.runner: Matteo and Franco argue about football at the table: Milan vs Inter.

grammar.name: Numbers 0–100
grammar.scope: cardinal numbers 0–100; phone numbers, addresses, ages; qual è il tuo numero?

chapters.theme: Personal information, forms, the town hall
chapters.a_plot: Ben goes to the town hall to register the family's residence. Forms, numbers, the wrong office, and a clerk who only says 'Il prossimo!'
chapters.b_plot: Emma has to give her number to classmates and panics about saying it in Italian; Bianca takes her phone and does it for her. Their friendship begins.
chapters.runner: Ben's notebook: page 3, 'diciassette' underlined three times.

grammar.name: Adjectives: agreement and position
grammar.scope: four-form and two-form adjectives; agreement; position after the noun; bello/buono before nouns as fixed forms; molto + adjective

chapters.a_plot: Bianca interrogates Emma about the quiet boy on the train, who turns out to be Tommaso Colombo, the neighbour from behind the hedge.
chapters.b_plot: Leo describes every neighbour to Ben for his 'map of people'. Roberto is 'alto e antipatico', Ornella is 'vecchia ma elegante'.
chapters.runner: Franco describes Ben to Matteo as 'alto, americano, inutile'. Ben overhears the first two words.

grammar.name: Present tense: -are verbs
grammar.scope: regular -are verbs (parlare, abitare, lavorare, mangiare, comprare, preparare, decorare); -care/-gare and -iare spelling

chapters.a_plot: Ben decorates the house for Halloween, American-size. The street is scandalised because it's Ognissanti, when Italians visit the cemetery. Franco explains the day by taking Ben with him to bring flowers to Anna.
chapters.b_plot: Leo organises trick-or-treating; only Ornella and, secretly, Marina Colombo open their doors.
chapters.runner: Roberto files a complaint about the inflatable pumpkin.
chapters.arc: The first real Ben–Franco moment, at Anna's grave.

grammar.name: Question words and negation
grammar.scope: chi, che cosa, dove, quando, come, perché, quanto/a/i/e, quale; non + verb; sì/no answers; intonation questions

chapters.theme: School life and asking for information
chapters.a_plot: Leo's day of a thousand questions: at school with Maestra Paola, at the bar with Matteo, at the orto with Franco. Franco answers every one.
chapters.b_plot: Chiara is questioned by Marchetti about her project, and by her team about America. She answers too fast in both languages.
chapters.runner: Ben can't answer any of Leo's questions and writes them all in his notebook.

grammar.name: Present tense: -ere and -ire verbs
grammar.scope: regular -ere (leggere, scrivere, prendere, vedere, vivere) and -ire (dormire, aprire, partire, sentire) verbs; -isc- verbs (capire, finire, preferire)

chapters.a_plot: Ben's first evening Italian class at the Centro civico with Alberto. During the break he opens the wrong door and finds Franco dancing a tango with Lucia.
chapters.b_plot: Emma fails her first Italian test at the liceo ('Capisco tutto, ma non scrivo bene!'). Tommaso quietly lends her his notes.
chapters.arc: SECRET ARC begins: Franco makes Ben promise not to tell anyone. It's the first thing Franco has ever asked him.

grammar.name: Irregular verbs: fare, andare, venire
grammar.scope: present forms; andare a/in + place; venire da; fare + common expressions (fare colazione, fare la spesa, fare una foto)

chapters.theme: Transport and going places: train, tickets, the city
chapters.a_plot: Ben takes the kids into Milan for a Saturday: tickets, the wrong platform, the metro, the Duomo. Emma pretends not to know him.
chapters.b_plot: Franco invents excuses to explain why he goes 'to the Centro civico' three evenings a week. Ben covers for him badly.
chapters.runner: Leo photographs every pigeon in Piazza del Duomo.

grammar.name: Possessive adjectives
grammar.scope: mio/tuo/suo/nostro/vostro/loro, agreement; no article with singular family nouns (mia madre) but article with loro and plurals

chapters.a_plot: Leo's school project, 'La mia famiglia'. He interviews everyone and discovers the family tree is confusing: nonno Franco, zio Matteo, 'zia' Nadia (not married!).
chapters.b_plot: Chiara finds photos of her mother Anna in Franco's house and cries; Lucia's scarf is on the chair and she doesn't notice. Ben does.
chapters.runner: Franco asks Nadia when she and Matteo will get married. Nadia: 'Mai.'

grammar.name: Simple prepositions
grammar.scope: di, a, da, in, con, su, per, tra/fra; basic uses (place, origin, company, purpose)

chapters.a_plot: Christmas preparations: an American tree vs Franco's presepe; Ben hides the presents and forgets where.
chapters.b_plot: Franco wants Lucia at Christmas Eve dinner and begs Ben for help. Ben's plan: to invite 'a friend from the Italian course'.
chapters.runner: Matteo sells panettone at the bar and eats most of it.

grammar.name: Articulated prepositions
grammar.scope: a/di/da/in/su + article (al, del, dal, nel, sul...); location phrases (sul tavolo, nella cucina, al bar)

chapters.theme: Christmas Eve dinner, table, food at home
chapters.a_plot: Christmas Eve dinner at Franco's. 'Ben's friend from the course' arrives, and Lucia is wonderful. Everyone loves her, and no one understands why Franco is so nervous.
chapters.b_plot: Emma sees Tommaso at midnight mass; they talk for the first time without Bianca.
chapters.arc: Lucia enters the family's life under a false identity.

grammar.name: Time, days, months, dates
grammar.scope: che ore sono? / a che ora?; days of the week; months; dates (il 6 gennaio); seasons

chapters.a_plot: The Befana: Lucia comes to fill the kids' stockings. Chiara recognises the scarf and puts everything together: her father has a girlfriend, and Ben knew.
chapters.b_plot: Ben tries to plan the family calendar for January in Italian; the whole family has conflicting times.
chapters.arc: SECRET ARC explodes: Chiara is furious with Franco and with Ben.

grammar.name: Modal verbs: volere, potere, dovere
grammar.scope: present forms + infinitive; asking permission, expressing obligation and wishes

chapters.a_plot: Roberto delivers 'Il Regolamento di Via dei Tigli' to Ben: where he can park, when he must put out the bins, what he can't do to the hedge. Ben decides to follow every rule perfectly, to spite him.
chapters.b_plot: Chiara and Franco aren't speaking. Leo, Ben and Matteo try to make them talk: 'Dovete parlare!'
chapters.runner: The recycling calendar: Ben puts the paper out on plastic day.

title.en: I Like It, I Don't Like It

grammar.name: Piacere
grammar.scope: mi/ti/gli/le/ci/vi piace/piacciono; a me / anche a me / neanche a me; with nouns and infinitives

chapters.a_plot: Chiara agrees to a lunch with Lucia 'to get to know her'. Everything Lucia likes, Chiara pretends not to like. Leo keeps score out loud.
chapters.b_plot: Ben cooks an 'American dinner' for the Colombos as a peace offering. Roberto likes nothing; Marina likes everything, secretly.
chapters.arc: Chiara–Lucia: the first thaw, a very small one.

grammar.name: Reflexive verbs
grammar.scope: svegliarsi, alzarsi, lavarsi, vestirsi, chiamarsi, sentirsi, divertirsi; reflexive pronouns; position

chapters.a_plot: Chiara has an early meeting in Milan and the Carter morning collapses: one bathroom, four people, no coffee. Ben's 'perfect morning plan' lasts eight minutes.
chapters.b_plot: Franco's routine: up at 6, orto, bar, bocce. Leo spends a day copying it and falls asleep at the bocce court.
chapters.runner: Pavarotti the cat sleeps on Ben's side of the bed.

grammar.name: Irregular verbs: stare, dare, dire, uscire, bere
grammar.scope: present forms; come stai?; stare a casa; uscire con; dire di sì/no

chapters.a_plot: Emma asks to go out on Saturday night with Bianca, 'and others'. Ben says yes, Chiara says no, and Franco (unexpectedly) takes Emma's side.
chapters.b_plot: Ben goes out with Matteo for a 'guys' night' at the pizzeria. He drinks a cappuccino with his pizza, which is a scandal.

grammar.name: Demonstratives: questo and quello
grammar.scope: questo/a/i/e; quello with article-like forms (quel, quello, quell', quei, quegli, quella, quelle); as pronouns

chapters.a_plot: Carnevale: Leo needs a costume for the school parade, and the whole family has an opinion. Ben and Leo go costume-shopping, 'questo o quello?'
chapters.b_plot: Emma and Tommaso's first real conversation, throwing confetti at the Carnevale party at the Centro civico. Bianca pretends not to watch.
chapters.runner: Franco dresses as nothing: 'Io sono vestito da pensionato.'

grammar.name: Partitive and quantities; numbers 100+
grammar.scope: del/della/dei/delle; un po' di; un chilo di, un etto di, una bottiglia di; numbers above 100; prices in euros; quanto costa/costano?

chapters.a_plot: Franco takes Ben to the Tuesday market to teach him to shop 'properly'. Ben learns the etto, and learns you don't touch the fruit.
chapters.b_plot: Matteo's newest scheme to save the bar: 'brunch all'americana' on Sundays, with Ben as consultant. They shop for 30 people.
chapters.arc: Ben–Franco: the first time they have fun together.

grammar.name: Sapere vs conoscere
grammar.scope: present forms; sapere + fact/infinitive (so nuotare); conoscere + person/place

chapters.theme: Skills and abilities; people and places you know
chapters.a_plot: Chiara finally visits Lucia's dance class, alone. She discovers Lucia knew her mother Anna, who taught her a tiramisù recipe years ago.
chapters.b_plot: The Sunday brunch is a success, but Ben doesn't know how to use the professional coffee machine, and Matteo doesn't know how to make pancakes.
chapters.runner: Leo claims he 'knows' everyone in Borgoverde. He mostly does.
chapters.arc: Chiara–Lucia: a real bond begins, through Anna.

grammar.name: Adverbs of frequency and time expressions
grammar.scope: sempre, spesso, qualche volta, di solito, raramente, mai (non... mai); ogni giorno; prima/poi; weather expressions with fare/c'è/è

chapters.a_plot: Snow in Borgoverde, a rare event. The trains stop, school closes, and the whole street is stuck at home. Ben and Roberto dig out their cars side by side, in silence.
chapters.b_plot: Chiara works from home and realises how rarely she is there. Leo and Emma list what Ben 'always' and 'never' does.
chapters.runner: Franco: 'Nebbia a febbraio, freddo a marzo' (a proverb).

grammar.name: Stare + gerund
grammar.scope: present progressive: sto facendo, stai parlando; regular gerunds and fare/dire/bere

chapters.theme: Phone calls, messages, preparing a surprise
chapters.a_plot: The family secretly prepares Franco's 72nd birthday. The episode plays out in phone calls: 'Cosa stai facendo?' 'Niente!'
chapters.b_plot: Lucia and Chiara bake Anna's tiramisù together, from memory and from Lucia's recipe card.
chapters.runner: Franco suspects something and spies on everyone from the orto.

grammar.name: A1 review: the present tense
grammar.scope: Consolidation of all A1 structures: essere/avere, regular and irregular present, reflexives, modals, piacere; a simple toast (un brindisi)

chapters.a_plot: Franco's birthday dinner. Ben gives a toast in simple, heartfelt, imperfect Italian. Franco introduces Lucia to the whole family, properly this time.
chapters.b_plot: Emma invites Tommaso; Roberto and Marina come too, since everyone is invited on Via dei Tigli. An uneasy truce.
chapters.arc: SEASON FINALE: Franco raises his glass and says, for the first time, 'Grazie, Ben.'
